subject: Investor metrics: evidence handoff & pipeline sanity check
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Investor metrics: evidence handoff & pipeline sanity check

Team —

We need a fast, defensible sweep of Q2 numbers for the investor update. High level asks (please prioritize in this order):

1) Confirm commit-stage deals and attach evidence (signed PO/contract, SOW, purchase order or clear email trail). Mark any deals where legal redlines are outstanding.
2) For anything > $100k, add a one-line note on risk (e.g., legal, vendor approval, procurement timeline).
3) Clean stage mappings in HubSpot (Commit / Best Case / Commit - contingent) and flag any stage you want held from ARR/bookings.
4) Upload evidence to the Drive folder below and add filenames to this thread.

Deadline: 3:00 PM PT today. I attached a simple evidence template (Q2_evidence_template.xlsx) — use it for every large deal.

I will consolidate and produce an "evidence pack" for the investor binder after 3pm. If you expect a contract to land but it's not signed yet, call it out explicitly rather than moving it to Commit.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Q2_evidence_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Kim —

On it. Quick summary from my side after running the commit review:

- CloudSight expansion (ACV ~$240k): counterparty signed commercial term sheet; legal sent redlines this morning. Legal says changes are material but trackable. I attached the export plus the contract redlines.
- Opal Analytics renewal (ACV ~$75k): procurement is asking for a PO; customer has verbally committed but no PO yet — recommend Best Case not Commit until PO arrives.
- 7 smaller renewals (<$30k each): all in Commit and evidence attached (signed invoices).

I uploaded pipeline_export_20260707.csv and CloudSight_contract_redlines.pdf to the Drive folder. For CloudSight, we should decide whether to include the $240k in the ARR corridor now or mark as contingent. My recommendation: count it in bookings corridor if legal confirms redline resolution by Friday (we can add a conditional note in the narrative).

Files attached: pipeline_export_20260707.csv; CloudSight_contract_redlines.pdf

—Marcus

Thanks all — good work. Final decisions for the investor narrative:

1) Count CloudSight ($240k) in the Q2 bookings corridor with a one-line caveat in the deck: "Included pending legal sign-off; expected by EOD Friday." Marcus — please confirm with Legal that sign-off timing is acceptable and escalate if not.
2) Opal Analytics ($75k) remains Best Case until PO is received; do not include in ARR until PO arrives.
3) Small renewals: include as booked.

Next steps:
- Marcus: confirm legal timing and drop final signed contract to the Drive folder when available.
- Vanessa: add the conditional narrative line to slide 6 and mark CloudSight evidence in the evidence tracker.
- Vivek: queue the numbers for the investor deck and include the caveat on slide notes. I will build the final evidence zip and circulate to the investor distribution list after you drop final artifacts.
